questions.topic: eGurukul · Anatomy - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Excruciating pain along the distribution of the Sciatic Nerve in Rectal Cancer is seen in:
questions.solutionHtml:
Anterior infiltration in Females
  • Sciatica in rectal cancer patients is seen due to the anterior infiltration in females. It occurs due to the perineural invasion of the inferior hypogastric plexus from which the sciatic nerve arises.
  • In females, the inferior hypogastric plexus lies anterolateral to the rectum whereas in males, it lies lateral to the rectum.


Gray’s anatomy: The anatomical basis of clinical practice - 42nd edition - page 1196.

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anatomy - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Patient with positive Trendelenburg sign what is the action of the muscle involved?
questions.solutionHtml:
Abduction and internal rotation
  • Trendelenburg sign is a test for neurological insufficiency of the gluteus medius and gluteus minimus muscles, which are innervated by the superior gluteal nerve.

Major action of both Gluteus medius and minimus is abduction of thigh and internal rotation

  • Anterior fibres (lateral portion): Internal rotation of the thigh
  • Posterior fibres (medial portion): External rotation of the thigh when the knee is in extension


B D Chaurasia’s Human Anatomy - 8th edition - volume 2 - page 82, 166, 212.

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anatomy - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Skull fracture at pterion causes injury to:

options.label: A
options.text: Most common site of fracture of skull

options.label: B
options.text: MMA is damaged in this injury

options.label: C
options.text: Fracture always occurs when patient falls sideways

options.label: D
options.text: It connects parietal, temporal, sphenoid and maxillary bones

questions.answerText: MMA is damaged in this injury
questions.solutionHtml:
MMA is damaged in this injury
  • Traumatic blow to the pterion may rupture the middle meningeal artery causing an epidural haematoma.


Gray’s Anatomy: The Anatomical Basis of Clinical Practice - 42nd edition - page 1464.

questions.stemHtml: Which is the nerve arising from the marked place? (SET - B)
questions.solutionHtml:
Abducens

The nerve indicated in the image is Abducens nerve (VI cranial nerve) which is a motor nerve that  supplies the lateral rectus muscle of the eye . It arises from the pontomedullary junction, passes through the Dorello’s canal .

Abducens nerve emerging out from pontomedullary junction

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anatomy - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Lower brachial plexus injury leads to Klumpke’s paralysis. The characteristic clinical finding is.
questions.solutionHtml:
Claw hand

Klumpke’s paralysis is a neuropathy involving the lower brachial plexus. The most common aetiology resulting in Klumpke palsy is a hyper-abduction trauma to the arm.  The patient may present with a "claw hand." This deformity presents a finger and wrist flexion.



B D Chaurasia’s Human Anatomy - 8th edition - volume 1 - page 62, 63, 109, 201.

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anatomy - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stemHtml: Which of the following is/ are derived from the marked structure? OdontoblastsSympathetic chainMelanocytesNephrogenic cordBulbus cordisConotruncal septumSelect the correct answer from the given below code:-
questions.solutionHtml:
1,2,3,6

The marked structure in the given image is neural crest cells near the neural tube.

Neural crest cells contribute to many organs and tissues:

  • Odontoblasts
  • Melanocytes
  • Sensory ganglia
  • Sympathetic and enteric neurons
  • Schwann cells
  • Adrenal medulla cells
  • Craniofacial skeleton
  • Neurons for cranial ganglia
  • Conotruncal septum of heart
  • C cells of the thyroid gland
  • Smooth muscle cells to blood vessels of face and forebrain


Langman’s Medical Embryology - 14th edition - page 76-85.

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anatomy - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Which of the following nerves is blocked for hernia surgery, femoral catheter local anaesthesia is given just below the inguinal ligament for placing the femoral catheter?

options.label: C
options.text: Lateral cutaneous nerve of the thigh

questions.solutionHtml:
Genitofemoral nerve
  • Genitofemoral nerve is blocked when the local anaesthesia is given just below the inguinal ligament during femoral vein catheterisation.
  • The genitofemoral nerve originates from L1 and L2 ventral rami, divides into genital and femoral branches after crossing behind the ureter.


Gray’s Anatomy: The Anatomical Basis of Clinical Practice - 42nd edition - page No-1464.

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anatomy - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Which of the following is not a branch of the posterior division of the internal iliac artery/ vein?
questions.solutionHtml:
Inferior gluteal artery

Six branches of the anterior division

  • Umbilical artery, obturator artery, inferior vesical artery (in males), middle rectal artery, internal pudendal artery, and inferior gluteal artery.
  • Posterior division of the internal iliac artery supplies parietal structures of the pelvis and gluteal region ( S  I  L )- iliolumbar artery, lateral sacral arteries, and superior gluteal artery.
  • Option D: Inferior gluteal artery is a branch of anterior division.


Gray’s Anatomy: The Anatomical Basis of Clinical Practice - 42nd edition - Page No. 1309.

questions.topic: eGurukul · Anatomy - INI CET NOVEMBER 2022 (PART - B)
questions.stem: Which statements are correct about the internal capsule? Charcot’s artery supplies the posterior limbRetro lenticular part of the internal capsule contains optic radiationAnterior limb of the capsule contains corticospinal tract fibres of the upper limb and faceInternal capsule is example of projection fibresSelect the correct answer from the given below code:-
questions.solutionHtml:
1,2,4
  • Charcot’s artery supplies the posterior limb
  • Retrolentiform part contains optic radiation
  • Sublentiform part contains auditory radiation
  • Internal capsule has projection fibres
  • Statement 3 is not correct as anterior limb has frontopontine fibres


Gray’s anatomy: The anatomical basis of clinical practice - 41st edition - page 418.

questions.stemHtml: Muscle attached to the arrow marked bony structure is
questions.solutionHtml:
